HEADLINE: Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 & 33 read with Schedule III & other applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we ....
MORE:
Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 & 33 read with Schedule III & other applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that, the Board of Directors of the company at their meeting held on 04th November 2026 has approved the following:

1. Financial Results : Approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter & Half Year ended 30th September 2026 along with Limited Review Report as received from the Statutory Auditor of the Company.

2. Resignation of Director : Approved the resignation of Mr. Kamlesh Kotak (DIN : 00012755) as Director of the Company from the close of Business Hours on 04th November 2026, due to reason mentioned in the resignation letter.

3. Reconstitution of Stakeholder Relationship Committee : Approved the Reconstitution of Stakeholder Relationship Committee, consequent to resignation of Mr. Kamlesh Kotak (DIN : 00012755)
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 04Th November 2026, Under Regulation 30 Read With 33(3) Of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

Abhinav Capital Services Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 04/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulations 29 & 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Wednesday, 04th November 2026 at 04:00 P.M. at the registered office of the Company to consider & approve unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended & half year ended 30th September 2026 & other agenda item as per notice served to the Board Members.

Please note that the Trading Window for dealing in the Company''s shares has been closed from October 1, 2026, and will reopen 48 hours after the declaration of unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.
